objective: 完成 B3 的固定 Judge 协议、重复裁判、加权 gold-claim recall、双人标注包和校准工具，并明确区分自动一致性与尚未完成的人工校准。

overrides.generation: reuse B2 frozen reports; no Planner/Reader/Synthesizer rerun

components.name: JudgeProtocol
components.implementation: Versioned prompt and label contract with SHA-256 fingerprint

components.name: LLMJudge
components.implementation: Two repeated evidence-grounded decisions per frozen report with fixed claim-order seeds
components.notes: Six successful calls; raw traces retained.

components.name: HumanCalibration
components.implementation: Two independent packets, one adjudication packet, agreement and precision/recall tooling
components.notes: Infrastructure is complete, but all human labels remain null/pending.

protocol.notes: The first restricted-sandbox preflight timed out; the approved external-network run completed all six calls on first attempt.

metric_definitions.name: weighted_gold_claim_recall
metric_definitions.definition: Required authored claim weights multiplied by Judge coverage score (covered=1, partial=0.5, missing/contradicted=0), divided by total required weight.
metric_definitions.limitations: Not calibrated against completed human labels.

metric_definitions.name: repeated_judge_agreement
metric_definitions.definition: Exact status agreement and Cohen's kappa across repeated Judge decisions aligned by stable claim ID.
metric_definitions.limitations: Same-model agreement measures repeatability, not correctness.

metric_definitions.name: automatic_vs_human_precision_recall
metric_definitions.definition: Per-label and macro precision/recall against completed adjudicated human labels.
metric_definitions.limitations: Cannot be measured until two independent annotators and adjudication are complete.

metrics.name: judge_fallback_count
metrics.notes: No rule fallback in the successful pilot.

metrics.name: report_claim_status_agreement
metrics.notes: Two same-model repetitions on each of three reports.

metrics.name: gold_claim_status_agreement
metrics.notes: Two same-model repetitions on each sample.

metrics.name: mean_citation_correctness
metrics.notes: All report claims closely reproduce cited Evidence, while task coverage remains low.

observations: All repeated Judge outputs aligned through stable report-claim and gold-claim IDs despite deterministic input shuffling.
Citation correctness of 1.0 coexists with low weighted task coverage, demonstrating that evidence support and answer completeness must remain separate metrics.
The three reports were produced by deterministic rule agents and are useful for protocol validation, not representative final-system quality.
Same-model kappa of 1.0 cannot establish semantic correctness without independent human labels.

changed_variables: two repeated real LLM Judge calls per sample
comparison.notes: The reports and frozen sources are identical to B2, but coverage now uses authored claim weights and semantic Judge labels. Human validity is not yet comparable.

artifacts.notes: Raw prompts, parsed outputs, token usage and one separate restricted-network timeout trace.

limitations: No human labels have been completed; automatic-vs-human precision/recall and human kappa are not measured.
Both repetitions use the same DeepSeek profile, so agreement may overstate robustness across judge families.
The reports come from deterministic rule generation and contain evidence-like wording, which makes citation support unusually easy.
Only three draft Chinese smoke samples were judged; there is no confidence interval or domain/language coverage.
Provider cost was not returned by the compatible API, so cost_usd remains unavailable.
The worktree remains dirty; commit hash alone does not reconstruct the implementation.
next_actions: Have two real annotators complete their packets independently.
Adjudicate every disagreement and preserve reasons rather than copying automatic labels.
Run scripts/calibrate_b3_annotations.py and compare report-claim and gold-claim precision/recall, agreement and kappa.
If calibration meets a predeclared threshold, close B3 and start B4; otherwise revise rubric/protocol and create a new versioned experiment.
